BIKAS J DAS PROJECT MANAGER — PAYMENTS & BANKING Phone: +91 8591823307 | Email: bikasdas08@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Result-oriented Project Manager offering over 13+ years of progressive expertise in Banking and Financial Services (BFSI). Proven track record of 10+ years managing cross-functional project teams, leading end-to-end delivery schedules, optimizing business processes, and executing high-impact system modernizations across Cash Management Services (CMS), ISO 20022 Payments Migration, SWIFT Sanctions Screening, Payment Gateways, and Retail Banking. Adept at bridging business and technology teams, managing project Scope, Schedule, and Budget, and leveraging AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Open Code AI) to accelerate legacy codebase analysis and deliver actionable functional specifications. Expert in complete Project & SDLC Management, Agile Backlog Management, Risk Mitigation, Resource Allocation, and Stakeholder Alignment in high-volume payment ecosystems.

KEY CAREER HIGHLIGHTS

AI-Driven Application Migration: Accelerated the modernization of retail legacy applications (BMM to MWS) across ~30 business functions at HSBC by leveraging GitHub Copilot and Open Code AI tools.

ISO 20022 & SWIFT Modernization: Managed Citi Bank's ISO Migration project transitioning MT messages to MX standards (PAIN, PACS, CAMT) alongside SWIFT SAM Sanctions Screening integration.

API Banking & Module Overhaul: Spearheaded project delivery for the complete revamp of the Multi-City Cheque (MCC) module and integrated Real-Time and Bulk API Banking solutions at State Bank of India (SBI).

International Payment Gateway Launch: Directed the project implementation for BayanPay Payment Ltd (KSA) Payment Gateway integration with strict adherence to regional compliance protocols, digital wallets, and merchant dashboards.

Government Payments & Reconciliation: Functioned as Application Owner and Project Manager for PFMS at HDFC Bank (ACH, NHM) and designed an automated daily Reconciliation Module for GL Pool accounts.

Enterprise Product Innovation: Led the project launch of the "Virtual Pool" liquidity management solution for elite corporate accounts at Axis Bank, along with automated CBA and charge reversal tools.

CORE COMPETENCIES & TECHNICAL SKILLS

Project Management & Governance: End-to-End Project Delivery, Scope & Schedule Management, Risk Assessment & Mitigation, Resource Allocation, Budget Tracking, Agile/Scrum & Waterfall, Stakeholder Alignment, Vendor Management.

Payments Domain: ISO 20022 Migration (PAIN, PACS, CAMT), SWIFT Messaging, NACH/ACH, NEFT, RTGS, Payment Gateways, Real-time & Bulk API Banking, Cash Management Services (CMS), Sanctions Screening, PFMS.

Requirements & Delivery: Business Requirements Document (BRD), Functional Specifications Document (FSD), Gap Analysis, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Product Backlog Refinement, Business Process Modeling (BPMN).

Testing, Delivery & Execution: User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Planning & Governance, Defect Management, Go-Live Strategy, Post- Implementation Support.

Tools & Technologies: JIRA, Confluence, GitHub Copilot, Open Code AI Tools, XML, SQL Querying, Data Mapping, MS Project, Visio.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Project Manager | Virtusa Consulting Private Ltd Private Banking & Retail Banking – EMEA Region

Oct 2022 – Present

Serve as Requirement Custodian, Project Manager, and primary liaison between Senior Business Stakeholders and Engineering teams to define, prioritize, and manage project milestones using Agile/Scrum and Waterfall methodologies.

Lead project execution for legacy application migration from BMM to modern MWS platform across ~30 business functions, utilizing GitHub Copilot and Open Code AI tools to accelerate legacy code analysis and reduce turnaround time by 30%.

Manage project deliverables, risks, and dependencies while authoring detailed artifacts including Business Requirements Documents (BRD), Functional Specification Documents (FSD), Use Cases, Process Flow diagrams, and Interface specifications.

Direct ISO 20022 migration delivery strategy for Citi Bank client, executing end-to-end data mapping for legacy MT messages to MX standards (PAIN, PACS, CAMT) within planned project schedules.

Manage Sanction screening integration project for SWIFT messaging within the SAM Application to ensure strict global regulatory compliance.

Manage User Acceptance Testing (UAT) strategy, resource scheduling, defect tracking, business sign-off approvals, and post- implementation support.

Principal Project Analyst | Aurionpro Solutions Ltd

Aug 2022 – Oct 2022

Managed project delivery timelines, requirement gathering, and feature rollouts for Corporate Banking – CMS solutions.

Senior Project Manager | Tech Mahindra Limited Corporate Banking – Cash Management Services (Deputed to State Bank of India)

Jun 2021 – Jul 2022

Functioned as Lead Payments Consultant and Project Manager for State Bank of India (SBI), driving delivery for bulk payment processing solutions, corporate payments, government disbursements, and mandate systems.

Conceptualized project roadmaps and managed execution across Cash Management Services (CMS) enhancements within target timelines.

Led project lifecycle for complete revamp of Multi-City Cheque (MCC) module and integrated Real-time & Bulk API Banking solutions to significantly increase transaction throughput.

Managed Gap Analysis, risk management, system analysis, and formulated High-Level Design (HLD) and FSD artifacts for complex multi- system integrations.

• Conducted steering committee presentations, project status demos, and technical workshops for Sales and Senior Executive teams.

Project Manager | Unimoni Enterprise Solution Pvt Ltd Digital Solutions – Payment Gateway

Apr 2019 – Jul 2020

Managed project execution and requirement engineering for Digital Payment Gateways and B2B/B2C Digital Wallet solutions. • Collaborated with international client teams (BayanPay Payment Ltd, KSA) on Payment Gateway integration projects, ensuring strict alignment with Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) regional regulatory standards and target schedules.

Managed project backlogs, Epics, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and merchant dashboard functional delivery. • Managed cross-functional team tracking to guarantee on-time delivery and served as functional analyst for core updates. Jun 2016 – Mar 2019

Managed project backlogs, Epics, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and merchant dashboard functional delivery. • Managed cross-functional team tracking to guarantee on-time delivery and served as functional analyst for core updates. Jun 2016 – Mar 2019

Acted as Application Owner and Project Manager for high-volume payments projects including NACH/ACH, PFMS, and NHM. • Managed project timelines, formulated standardized BRD/FSD templates, conducted rigorous UAT execution within strict turnaround times (TAT), and achieved business sign-offs across multiple stakeholders.

Managed design and implementation of automated Reconciliation Module within PFMS framework to reconcile daily high-volume transactions across GL Pool accounts accurately.

Project Lead / Officer | Axis Bank Ltd Business Banking / Transaction Banking – Current Account Product

Dec 2011 – May 2016

Led project enhancement workflows, charge master design, and scheme code configurations for Current Account (CA) portfolios. • Managed the end-to-end launch of "Virtual Pool" product tailored for elite corporate accounts, enhancing liquidity management capabilities.

Facilitated cross-functional project management with IT and operational teams to implement automated tools, including Cost Benefit Analysis (CBA) calculators, Charge Reversal modules, and Peer Bank Comparator sales tools.

Automated branch operations including DD/PO revalidation and duplicate statement generation to eliminate manual operational overhead.

CERTIFICATIONS & TRAINING

Certification: SWIFT MT Message Types and ISO 20022 MX • Internal Training: Data Privacy & Retail Banking • Internal Training: Business Analysis & Project Management Frameworks EDUCATION

Master of Commerce (M.Com) – Banking & Finance — University of Mumbai | First Class (69.00%) | 2014 Bachelor of Management Studies (B.M.S) — University of Mumbai | First Class (70.00%) | 2011
